channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Hazard on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of hazard, westbound, on the N25 between Junction 3 Cobh and Junction 2 Little Island (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 18 February at 07:14.

item.title: Breakdown on M8 Southbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, southbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 16 Rathcormac and Junction 17 Watergrasshill (near Watergrasshill). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 18 February at 07:52.

item.title: Over €216 Million in Road Funding Announced for Cork County
item.description: Nearly €235m in road funding announced for Cork city and county, including the N25 Midleton to Youghal scheme and M28 currently under construction.

item.title: Over 58,000 Cork Homes Eligible for Free GAA+ Subscription Through National Broadband Plan
item.description: Over 58,000 Cork homes may be eligible for a free €95 GAA+ subscription through the National Broadband Plan.

item.title: Free Help to Quit Smoking Available This National No Smoking Day
item.description: Today is National No Smoking Day (and Ash Wednesday, ironically.) Free support and medication available through HSE South West to help you quit.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 10 Mahon and Jack Lynch Tunnel West Entrance (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 18 February at 09:45.

item.title: Cabinet Considers Plans for Social Media Ban for Under-16s
item.description: Cabinet considers plans to restrict social media for under-16s as new Digital and AI Strategy is brought to Government.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

item.title: Drone Delivery Test Flights Expected in Cork Within Days as Airspace Restrictions Set to Be Revised
item.description: Manna drone delivery test flights are understood to be imminent in Cork city, as IAA airspace restrictions look set to be significantly revised.

item.title: Government Unveils 90-Point Plan to Make Ireland a Global Digital and AI Leader by 2030
item.description: Government launches 90-action Digital and AI Strategy to position Ireland as a global leader by 2030.

item.title: Collision on N72 Mallow
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N72 Mallow near Applegreen. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.
